title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as Warsh keeps inflation fight front and centre
summary: US stocks ended lower as Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reaffirmed the central bank’s focus on bringing inflation to 2%, raising expectations for a possible September rate hike. The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell, while Nvidia and other tech stocks weakened. Investors also assessed mixed corporate earnings and economic data.

title: FDI clarifications in works to help investors from land border nations
summary: India is clarifying foreign direct investment rules for bordering nations.  These clarifications will guide investors from countries sharing land borders.
